_comment: Ground truth measured from ~/Downloads/IMG_4913.HEIC (iPhone 17 Pro).
That file is the user's private capture and is NOT committed; this is the
distilled reference so `tohdr verify` and the test suite can assert against
it on any machine. Sources: heif_detail.py box walk, exiftool -G1 -a -s, and
the committed 62-byte tmap payload img4913_iso21496.bin decoded field by
field. See docs/heic-gainmap-structure.md and docs/acceptance-criteria.md.

ftyp._comment: 'tmap' is what advertises ISO 21496-1 signaling to a reader that checks brands before parsing items.

_comment: Both the base (46) and the gain map (62) are `grid` items -- Apple tiles
both. Our muxer emits single non-grid items instead, which is simpler and
strictly easier for a consumer to decode; the grid is not part of the
gain-map contract. Item counts in the original: 113 hvc1 tiles, 3 grid,
4 mime (XMP), 1 tmap, 1 'uri ', 1 Exif.
The gain map is auxiliary to the base ALONE. The tmap's dimg lists base
first, gain second -- that order is load-bearing for an ISO reader.
Other auxiliary images in the file (depth, mattes) point at [46, 122],
which is why a raw auxC count of 6 is not a gain-map requirement.
Half the base resolution in each axis. bytes_per_row (3200) exceeds width
(2856): ImageIO hands back row-padded planes, so a consumer must honor the
stride. Data length as ImageIO reports it: 6854400 == 3200 * 2142.
max_log2 == alt_headroom exactly. This is the invariant both washed-out
exports break and the single most important thing to reproduce.
Apple's gamma is 0.825684 and its offsets are 1e-5 -- NOT the ISO/UltraHDR
nominal defaults of gamma 1.0 and offsets 1/64, which are ~650x larger and
lift near-black far harder.
Apple writes the headroom THREE times and all three agree to ~1e-4. A file
whose copies disagree is one where some consumer reads the wrong one.
tag48 is POSITIVE; the broken export's -0.008120966145 is what
toGainMapHDR's unclamped (3.0 - stops)/70 branch emits above 8x.

icc_profiles.tmap: Display P3 Primaries; PQ (Adaptive Gain Curve 81B7427DF220A6FA)
